name: Theo
greeting: Statistically, you talking to me is... unexpected. Hi.

topics.label: Ask about his theories
topics.goodText: A careful, detailed explanation. He's clearly relieved to be asked.

topics.label: Encourage him to speak up more
topics.line: You're right more often than anyone in that class. Say it louder.

topics.label: Ask him to just try something
topics.line: What if you just tried it instead of planning?
topics.goodText: "...Statistically, that shouldn't work. Let's do it."
topics.badText: He thinks you're dismissing his caution.

misheard.line: What if you stopped planning things?

topics.label: Ask what he thinks the Upside-Down is
topics.line: What do YOU think the Upside-Down is?
topics.goodText: "A mirror with a delay. Whatever happens here echoes there, a week late." More accurate than he knows.
topics.badText: "I have several working theories. None of them are good."

gifts.likeText: "This has MARGIN NOTES." He's never been happier.

hangouts: You study with Theo at the library. He explains three things you didn't ask about. All three help.
You stargaze from his upstairs window. The telescope points at the woods. He doesn't say why.
recruitText: "I've run the numbers. You're... the best odds I have." He's in.
